name: devbook-skills
description: Reusable guidance any plugin can name and none has to depend on. Ships show-me: put a picture before the prose whenever the content has a shape — a Mermaid sequence, state, or flow diagram, a file tree labelled with what each entry is for, a type signature, a diff, a call stack, pseudocode, or a table — and keep the prose after it to the reasons, the exceptions, and the limits. Ships research-brief: answer one question about something outside the repository from primary sources only, every claim cited with a confidence, and say what the sources leave open; it returns the brief and writes nothing, so the caller decides where it lands. Ships pr-body: write a pull request description as Summary, Evidence, and Merge Danger — one picture of the change, a tiered before and after, and a one-way or two-way door with its blast radius, a one-way door linking its decision record — inside the repository's own template. Named by skill, never declared: devbook's devbook-writing rule names show-me for every chapter but domain.md, the delivery engine names it for pull request descriptions and its report back to the person, the engine's scope and arc42 and tech drafting name research-brief, and the engine's pull request phase and the schedule sweeps' draft pull requests name pr-body, each keeping its own rule when the skill is absent. Materializes nothing into a repository and stamps nothing.
